note: Audited per-team offseason state derived from the reconciled feed — how each team's July actually happened, which the raw cap sheet can't show. Five audit agents replayed every feed signing against the exception system; rationale fields are the per-signing audit trail. Ambiguous forced-renounce sets follow a prefer-largest-holds rule and carry confidence: medium.

ATL.rationale: Jock Landale 1y/$14.0M (y1 14,000,000, prior ATL): 2025-26 salary was the minimum ($2,296,274), so his Non-Bird ceiling (120%) is ~$2.76M and even the Early-Bird 105%-of-average prong (~$13.86M) falls short of $14M — the Bird family cannot produce this deal. Confirmed by in-world reporting (Yossi Gozlan: 'The Hawks will use nearly their entire $15 million mid-level exception… His Non Bird rights are too low'; hoopsrumors.com/2026/06/jock-landale-re-signing-with-hawks.html) ⇒ NT-MLE $14.0M consumed, first-apron hard cap. CORRECTED from an earlier own-re-sign misread. Kingston Flemings / Zuby Ejiofor rookie-scale; Henri Veesaar 2nd-round exception; C.J. McCollum extension.

BKN.rationale: Own re-signs (Jun 29, options declined then re-signed — Bird family, consume nothing): Day'Ron Sharpe 2y/$20M (y1 9,756,098), Josh Minott 2y/$9M (y1 4,390,244). Outside deals: Keon Ellis (prior CLE) 2y/$18M y1 8,780,488 (Jun 30); Moritz Wagner (prior ORL) 2y/$19M y1 9,268,293 (Jul 1). Both exceed the TP-MLE and cannot share one NT-MLE (aggregate 18,048,781 > 15,044,000) ⇒ room team. But room alone can't cover both either: post-re-sign base = 171,142,688 committed − 18,048,781 = 153,093,907, leaving max 11,867,093 of room even with every hold renounced. The only arithmetic that closes: Ellis signed into cap room, Wagner via the Room MLE — 9,268,293 of 9,366,000, $97,707 under the full Room MLE (just outside the ±60k heuristic, but the signing order Jun 30 → Jul 1 and the room math both support it). Forced renounced: keepable holds ≤ 164,961,000 − 153,093,907 − 8,780,488 = 3,086,605 vs 75,481,187 of current holds ⇒ shed ≥ 72,394,582; minimal largest-holds set is the 12 listed (keeps only Grant Nelson's 2,449,421). Ambiguity: any ONE of the three ~2.45M holds (tre scott / malachi smith / grant nelson) could be the survivor, or all 13 were renounced; roster charges ignored. Two-ways skipped (Chaney Johnson QO, Tyler Bilodeau); Mikel Brown Jr. rookie scale. Room/Room-MLE usage triggers no apron hard cap. NOTE: in-world reporting (Hoops Rumors, Jul 1) said BKN 'could have just under $25MM in cap space remaining' — materially more room than this sheet implies, so the 12-hold forced-renounce set may be too aggressive; revisit if a Nets user disputes it.

BOS.rationale: Mitchell Robinson (prior NYK) 3y/$47.3886M: y1 = 15,796,200×3/3.15 = 15,044,000 — the FULL 2026-27 Non-Taxpayer MLE to the exact dollar; decisive NT-MLE usage → first-apron hard cap. Mike Conley (prior MIN) 1y/3,876,529 = vet-min scale top exactly → minimum exception, consumes nothing. Ron Harper Jr.: BOS declined his $2.58M option then re-signed 3y/$8.99M (y1 2,853,551) — own re-sign AND min-sized, consumes nothing. Amari Williams two-way (skip); Chris Cenac Jr. rookie scale; Neemias Queta extension. BOS committed ~$198.2M — over the cap but under the first apron, consistent with full NT-MLE use.

CHA.rationale: Coby White 3y/$74M (y1 = 24,666,667×3/3.15 = 23,492,064): OWN re-sign — in this world's base data his 2025-26 team is CHA (contracts-2025-26.json, $12,888,889) — Bird, consumes nothing at any amount. No other CHA feed signings and no trade rows involving him (not an S&T). CHA committed ~$167.1M post-re-sign, a routine over-cap Bird outcome; no exception use, no hard cap.

CHI.rationale: Norman Powell (prior MIA) 2y/$45M: y1 = 22,500,000×2/2.05 = 21,951,220 > NT-MLE (15,044,000) ⇒ must be a cap-room signing → operatedUnderCap, NT/TP-MLE+BAE dead for the year; no trade row for Powell, so not an S&T. Room math: committed 142,783,119 − 21,951,220 = 120,831,899 pre-spree base; keepable holds ≤ 164,961,000 − 120,831,899 − 21,951,220 = 22,177,881 vs 35,303,610 current holds ⇒ must shed ≥ 13,125,729. Largest-hold solution: Jaden Ivey (19,203,610) alone, leaving Richards+Yabusele (16,100,000) intact ≤ 22.18M. Ambiguity: renouncing Richards (9.5M) + Yabusele (6.6M) and keeping Ivey also balances — hence medium confidence, Ivey listed per the prefer-largest rule. Zach Collins is an extension; Caleb Wilson / Dailyn Swain rookie scale; Sellers/Awaka two-way. Post-feed CHI sits ~$142.8M, under the cap — consistent with a room team; no Room MLE signing observed (nothing near 9,366,000) and no hard cap.

CLE.rationale: Thomas Bryant 1y/3,524,948: OWN re-sign (prior CLE) and also minimum-sized (3,524,948 ≤ 3,916,529) — consumes nothing on both grounds. Meleek Thomas = 2nd-round exception; Ernest Udeh Jr. two-way (skip). Keon Ellis LEAVING (prior CLE → BKN) only clears a CLE hold, no CLE consumption. CLE committed ~$185.9M — over-cap team with no MLE/BAE use and no in-world hard cap.

DAL.rationale: No feed FA signings for DAL in signings.json (only trades: Aldama/Biberovic in from MEM Jul 1, Sergio de Larrea in via 4-team deal Jun 24 — trades, not exception signings). No MLE/BAE usage, no S&T acquisition, no hard cap triggered by feed moves.

DEN.rationale: Tyus Jones 1yr $3,876,529 (y1 = min scale top exactly, prior DAL) — minimum exception, consumes nothing. Marvin Bagley III 1yr $3,506,659 (y1 below min top, prior DAL) — minimum exception, consumes nothing. No exception usage, no hard cap.

DET.rationale: John Collins 3yr/$51M (y1 16,190,476, prior LAC) — VERIFIED sign-and-trade: Jul 1 transaction reads 'contract with LA Clippers (LAC) as part of a sign-and-trade with Detroit (DET)' (same pattern as Kessler UTA→LAL); DET is the acquirer ⇒ hard-capped at first apron, consumes no MLE. Kevin Huerter 3yr/$27M (y1 8,571,429) — prior team DET in contracts-2025-26 (25-26 salary $17.99M) ⇒ own re-sign, Bird family, consumes nothing. Javonte Green 1yr $3,943,679 — prior team DET ⇒ own re-sign (y1 is $27,150 over the min+40k line, but Bird/Early Bird covers it: 175% of his $2,296,274 = $4,018,480), consumes nothing. Only cap consequence: first-apron hard cap from the Collins S&T acquisition.

GSW.rationale: Al Horford 2yr/$13,985,100 (y1 = 6,822,000, prior GSW, declined $5.97M PO) — y1 is EXACTLY 120% of his $5,685,000 prior salary ⇒ Non-Bird own re-sign, consumes nothing. De'Anthony Melton 2yr/$11,227,850 (y1 = 5,477,000, prior GSW, declined $3.45M PO) — nominally an own re-sign, but y1 equals the BAE to the dollar and his Non-Bird max is only $3,697,105 (120% of $3,080,921) with no plausible Early Bird tenure, so the Bird family cannot produce this contract ⇒ classified as BAE usage per the exact-fingerprint evidence, which overrides the own-re-sign heuristic. BAE use ⇒ hard-capped at first apron. CONFIRMED in-world: Gozlan — 'Melton likely goes into the Warriors bi-annual exception… They still preserve their mid-level exception for a potential LeBron James signing' (hoopsrumors.com/2026/07/warriors-to-re-sign-deanthony-melton.html).

HOU.rationale: Tari Eason 5yr/$81.5M (y1 14,818,182, prior HOU, RFA off HOU qualifying offer) — own re-sign, Bird, consumes nothing. Marcus Smart 2yr/$13,054,400 (y1 = 6,368,000 exactly, prior LAL — declined $5.39M PO) — outside deal above TP-MLE ($6,064,000) and BAE ($5,477,000) but under NT-MLE ⇒ partial NT-MLE for $6,368,000 ⇒ hard-capped at first apron. Bogdan Bogdanovic 1yr $3,876,529 (y1 = min scale top exactly, prior LAC — option declined) — minimum exception, consumes nothing. Not near Room MLE; aggregate fits comfortably in one NT-MLE ⇒ no under-cap inference.

IND.rationale: Kelly Oubre Jr. 2yr/$17M (y1 = 8,292,683, prior PHI) — outside deal; above TP-MLE, not within ±$60k of Room MLE ($9,366,000, off by ~$1.07M), fits under NT-MLE ⇒ partial NT-MLE ⇒ hard-capped at first apron. Only feed signing for IND; single deal well within one NT-MLE, no under-cap evidence.

LAC.rationale: Jordan Miller 3y/$15.3M (y1=$4,857,143; prior LAC, option declined then QO'd — Bird re-sign, consumes nothing). Kobe Sanders 4y/$11.2M (y1=$2,604,651; prior LAC RFA, and minimum-sized anyway — consumes nothing). John Collins (prior LAC, $26.58M 2025-26): signed 3y/$51M (y1=$16,190,476) with LAC via Bird as part of a sign-and-trade to DET — the ACQUIRER (DET) is hard-capped at the first apron, not LAC; the outgoing S&T consumes no LAC exception. Committed $147.2M (over cap), no exception usage, no hard cap triggered.

LAL.rationale: Reaves 4y/$184.76M max (y1=$42,966,586; prior LAL, declined PO — Bird, consumes nothing). Kessler 4y/$130M (y1=$30,232,558) acquired via UTA sign-and-trade for picks only — no matching salary, absorbed into room; S&T acquisition hard-caps LAL at the first apron regardless. Outside deals: Grimes (prior PHI) y1=$13,953,488 and Mamukelashvili (prior TOR) y1=$12,093,023 — two NT-MLE-sized deals cannot share the one NT-MLE, and aggregate $35.4M (plus unmatched Kessler $30.2M) far exceeds NT-MLE+BAE ($20.5M), so LAL demonstrably operated under the cap (room signings; NT/TP-MLE+BAE dead per Art. VII 6(n)(1)/6(g)(3)). Sexton (prior CHI) y1=$9,366,000.00 — EXACTLY the Room MLE to the dollar, confirming room operation. Renounce math: pre-spree base $86,674,513; room used $56,279,069; max room with zero holds $78,286,487 leaves only $22.0M slack, and Reaves' retained Bird hold (~$20.9–26.5M at 150–190% of $13,937,574) plus incomplete-roster charges consumes it all — so LeBron James ($57,736,350), Rui Hachimura ($27,388,889), and Maxi Kleber ($20,900,000) holds are all mathematically incompatible and must be renounced. Ambiguity: at a 190% Reaves hold the sequence is ~$4.5M short even fully renounced (resolvable via ordering/hold treatment), hence medium confidence; the three listed renouncements are required under every ordering.

MEM.rationale: No 2026 offseason feed signings for MEM (committed $139.0M; FA holds Niang/Gordon et al. untouched). Nothing consumed, no hard cap.

MIA.rationale: Tim Hardaway Jr. 1y/$6.5M (prior DEN — outside deal). y1=$6,500,000 exceeds both the BAE ($5,477,000) and TP-MLE ($6,064,000) but fits the NT-MLE ($15,044,000); MIA is committed at $203.5M (well over cap, cannot be a room signing) so NT-MLE is the only lawful vehicle ⇒ first-apron hard cap. Simone Fontecchio 1y/$2.63M (y1=$2,625,627; prior MIA and minimum-sized — consumes nothing). MIA's $203.5M sits under the projected first apron, consistent.

MIL.rationale: Ousmane Dieng 3y/$17.5M (y1=$5,555,556): prior team is MIL in-world (MIL declined his QO Jun 29 — Bird rights survive a declined QO) ⇒ own re-sign via Bird, consumes nothing. No other feed signings. Committed $135.1M, no hard cap.

MIN.rationale: Ayo Dosunmu 5y/$112M (y1=$20,363,636): prior team is MIN per contracts-2025-26 (in-world, not CHI) ⇒ own re-sign via Bird, any amount, consumes nothing — NOT a room signing despite y1 > NT-MLE. Jaylen Clark 3y/$10M (y1=$3,174,603; prior MIN RFA and minimum-sized). Bones/Nah'Shon Hyland 1y/$2.85M (prior MIN, minimum-sized). Enrique Freeman two-way (skipped). Committed $216.6M over the cap via Bird re-signs; no exception used, no hard cap triggered.

NYK.rationale: Landry Shamet 4/24M y1 5,581,395 (prior NYK — own re-sign, Bird family); Jose Alvarado 3/14.58M y1 4,628,571 (declined $4.5M PO with NYK, prior NYK — own re-sign); Mohamed Diawara 4/10M y1 2,325,581 (prior NYK own re-sign, and below min threshold anyway); Andre Drummond 1yr y1 3,876,529 (prior PHI, exactly min scale — minimum exception). OKC.rationale: Isaiah Hartenstein 3/75M y1 23,809,524 (declined $28.5M option, prior OKC — own re-sign, Bird); Kenrich Williams 1/5M y1 5,000,000 (declined $7.16M option, prior OKC — own re-sign, Bird family); Brooks Barnhizer is a Two-Way (skipped, no cap salary). No outside deals at all; no exceptions used, no hard cap. OKC currently has zero FA holds in the pool.

ORL.rationale: Nikola Vucevic 1yr y1 3,876,529 (outside signing, exactly min scale top — minimum exception, consumes nothing); Jevon Carter 1yr y1 3,506,659 (prior ORL — own re-sign, and sub-minimum-threshold anyway); Colin Castleton is a Two-Way (skipped). No exceptions used, no hard cap. Bird holds for Jett Howard and Jase Richardson unaffected.

PHI.rationale: Dean Wade 4/39M y1 9,069,767 (prior CLE, outside deal; not Room-MLE-shaped — 296k off) + Anfernee Simons 2/12.247M y1 5,974,233 (prior CHI, outside deal; exceeds BAE 5.477M) sum to exactly 15,044,000 = the full 2026-27 NT-MLE split across two signings, hard-capping PHI at the first apron. Ariel Hukporti 1yr y1 3,400,000 (prior NYK) fits the minimum exception (≤ 3,916,529), consumes nothing. Rayan Rupert is a Two-Way per transactions; Caleb Love appears in signings.json as PHI but transactions show him agreeing to a Two-Way with POR — either way two-way/min-marker, skipped. Not a room team (NT-MLE use precludes it), so no forced renouncements of Lowry/Beauchamp/Watford/Martin holds.

PHX.rationale: Collin Gillespie 4/48M y1 11,162,791, Mark Williams 3/38M y1 12,063,492 (RFA, QO tendered), Jordan Goodwin 3/19M y1 6,031,746 — all prior team PHX, own re-signs via Bird rights, consume nothing (and confirm PHX operated over the cap). Luke Kennard 2/13.0544M y1 exactly 6,368,000 with a clean 5% raise (prior LAL, outside deal): above TP-MLE (6,064,000) and BAE (5,477,000), not Room-MLE-shaped, fits only as a partial NT-MLE use — hard cap at the first apron. Pat Spencer is a Two-Way (skipped). No room usage, so Coffey/Brea/Livers holds untouched.

POR.rationale: One feed signing: Branden Carlson 1yr/$2,449,421 (y1 = 2,449,421 <= min top 3,876,529) -> minimum exception, consumes nothing; prior team OKC (OKC declined his QO). Caleb Love is a two-way (skipped). POR committed 2026-27 = $172.8M (over cap, so no room usage possible anyway). Ja Morant arrived by trade, not signing. No MLE/BAE use, no hard cap.

SAC.rationale: Precious Achiuwa 2yr/$11.5M (y1 = 5,609,756): prior team SAC per contracts-2025-26 ($2,111,516) -> own re-sign, Bird family, consumes nothing per classification rule. Daeqwon Plowden 2yr/$5,113,822 (y1 = 2,494,547 <= min top) -> minimum exception (also own two-way RFA). Mogbo, Flagler two-ways skipped; Emanuel Sharp via 2nd-round exception. SAC committed = $211.6M, far over cap. Confidence medium only because Achiuwa spent a single year in SAC at $2.1M, so strict-CBA full Bird rights are questionable (a strict reading would put his y1 in TP-MLE range, 5,609,756 <= 6,064,000, implying a second-apron hard cap); the spec's own-re-sign rule controls here.

SAS.rationale: Tobias Harris 2yr/$30,840,200 from DET: y1 = 15,044,000, EXACTLY the full NT-MLE -> ntmle consumed in full, team hard-capped at first apron. Harrison Barnes 1yr/$8M: prior team SAS -> own Bird re-sign, consumes nothing. Gillespie/Brown two-ways and Quaintance/Reed rookie-scale skipped. SAS committed = $195.6M (over cap), consistent with over-cap NT-MLE usage; roster confirms Harris on the books at exactly $15,044,000.

TOR.rationale: Kyle Anderson 1yr/$3,876,529 from MEM: y1 exactly the min-scale top -> minimum exception, consumes nothing (lib carries a deemed-min cap charge of 2,449,421). Alijah Martin 2yr/$4,757,011 (y1 = 2,320,493 <= min top; own two-way RFA) -> minimum. Hepburn and Bradley two-ways skipped; Graves rookie scale. Kawhi arrived by trade. TOR committed = $199.5M, zero FA holds outstanding. No exception use, no hard cap.

UTA.rationale: Jusuf Nurkic 2yr/$22M (y1 = 10,731,707): prior team UTA -> own Bird re-sign, consumes nothing. Walker Kessler 4yr/$130M is a sign-and-trade OUT (UTA signs via Bird and sends to LAL): hard-caps the acquirer LAL, not UTA, and consumes no UTA exception. Trey Alexander/Bates two-ways skipped. Outside deals: Jaxson Hayes (LAL) y1 = 6,064,000 and Josh Okogie (HOU) y1 = 5,853,659. Room spree is mathematically impossible: committed = $171,505,322; pre-spree base = 159,587,663, leaving at most $5,373,337 of room even with ALL $50.9M of holds renounced -- less than Hayes alone -- so operatedUnderCap = false. Okogie exceeds the BAE (5,477,000) by $377k, so TP-MLE(Hayes)+BAE(Okogie) is incoherent; the only coherent over-cap attribution is the NT-MLE split across both players (6,064,000 + 5,853,659 = 11,917,659 <= 15,044,000; the NT-MLE is a splittable aggregate under CBA Art. VII 6(e)) -> first-apron hard cap. Confidence medium because Hayes's y1 is exactly TP-MLE-sized, suggesting the feed may have intended TP-MLE (which would imply a second-apron hard cap and leave Okogie unexplained).

WAS.rationale: Trae Young 4yr/$212,799,690 (y1 = 49,488,300): prior team WAS per contracts-2025-26 ($46.39M) and he declined a $48.97M WAS player option on Jun 17 -> own Bird (max) re-sign, consumes nothing at any amount. Jamir Watkins signed a two-way (skipped despite the $678,882 feed row). Deandre Ayton arrived by trade for Jaden Hardy (not a signing; no S&T marker). WAS committed = $190.4M (over cap). No exception use, no hard cap.
